summary: A Lake County lookout off State Road 33 that state forestry officials planned to sell by bid in 2010; no readable source gives its build or later history.

events.note: Florida forestry officials planned to put the tower out to bid in 2010, per the Orlando Sentinel's July 2010 report. The sources read do not say whether it sold.

Fire Lookouts Being Phased Out in Florida

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only Eva-specific source read is a July 2010 Orlando Sentinel item saying a sale was planned. Two Ledger articles from October 2010 (the Eva story and a follow-up) and an AnyPlaceAmerica tower record returned HTTP 403, and no archived copy was found, so they are unread. Build date, height, staffing and any sale or removal are unknown. The 2005 AP line covers all four Lake County state towers, not Eva by name; the story words it that way on purpose. Consider holding for the Ledger articles. Editor's note: the 2005 AP line (all four Lake County state towers still in use) and the 2010 Sentinel line (after Eva is sold, Paisley is the only tower left in the county) are not reconciled by any source read; the story presents them without linking them, and a reader may infer the county's tower count fell between 2005 and 2010.
